answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk forgery. Each epoch a beacon picks five auditors among agents who wandered across five markets, so no farm can bribe them. Each auditor, falcon-eyed, replays twenty past transactions and signs a verdict; a lantern is lit over matching trails. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 POA plus twenty real deals each; one honest agent pays only 40 POA and keeps full rewards, while exposed fakes lose bonds and votes.
